name: @sorenllm/opencode-forge
description: Single general-purpose forge agent for opencode: static worker subagents defined in forge.json (pinned model + thoughtLevel pair, or an Auto worker inheriting the parent model; dispatched through the native task tool — TUI-visible), a plan harness (file-backed plans with approve/close confirmation gates and a hard draft write-ban), a goal harness (autonomous, host-verified objectives), a /crew orchestration command (declared-plan waves with an evidence-checked close gate), a job supervisor (forge_shell with exit-bound completion, idle/success early return, background jobs with poll/log/kill/handoff), and a builtin-shell hang watchdog.
author: chengsongren
